title.description: The lesson in one line, phrased so it is useful before the failure happens again.

cause.description: Why the failure actually happened. Name the mechanism, not the symptom.

rule.description: The imperative rule that prevents it. One sentence a future turn can act on directly.

applies_when.description: The situation in which this rule matters, so it is not applied everywhere.

verification.description: How to check the rule was followed: a command, a response code, a string that must be present.

durable.description: True when this is a property of the environment, the platform or a library that will still be true in another run. False when it was a one-off mistake in this task.

research_query.description: A web search query that would confirm or refute the stated cause, when you are not certain of it. Leave empty when the cause is established by the evidence given.

confidence.description: How certain the cause is, from the evidence you were given.
